rationale: The assistant correctly identified 22E as a fridge-compartment fan error, most likely due to ice on the evaporator fan, and proposed the right first step: a full unplugged 24-48h manual defrost with doors open, moving food to a cool box. It correctly escalated to Samsung/engineer if the code recurs (defrost heater/sensor, fan motor), flagged warranty checking, and explicitly told the customer not to remove panels themselves. Minor gaps: it did not ask any clarifying questions, omitted the caution about sharp tools/hairdryers on ice, and 'almost always ice buildup' is slightly stronger than ideal, though it matches the hidden truth. No invented evidence, no parts pushed.
